help_target: Local container name: 1–63 letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter; existing targets must be mas-managed
help_hardware_item: Hardware item; omit to show all hardware information
help_hardware_value: on enables, off disables; omit to query; changes require a stopped container

help_unmountfs_path: Exact recorded mount path; omit to unmount the previously recorded default-home mount
help_cmd_new: Create a stopped container; default image matches the host Ubuntu release
help_cmd_list: List mas-managed containers and their states
help_cmd_start: Start the container and prepare sandbox and its GPU runtime; preserve recorded filesystem mounts
help_cmd_stop: Stop one container or all mas-managed containers; preserve recorded filesystem mounts
example_stop: Examples: mas stop sandbox; mas stop --all
help_cmd_delete: Delete a stopped container after confirmation, default No; recorded mounts must be removed first
help_cmd_info: Show complete container information and state
help_cmd_import: Import a LXD backup under a new name; the resulting container is stopped
help_cmd_export: Export a stopped container; overwriting a file requires confirmation, default No
help_cmd_enter: Reuse start and enter as sandbox; after the terminal finishes, stop, restart, return to mas or exit mas. Default: exit mas.

example_mountfs: Examples: mas mountfs sandbox; mas mountfs sandbox /var/log

example_unmountfs: Examples: mas unmountfs sandbox; mas unmountfs sandbox /var/log
help_cmd_mountedfs: Show recorded filesystem mounts and their current states

example_hardware: Examples: mas hardware sandbox; mas hardware sandbox gpu off
help_cmd_config: Read or change mas preferences without LXD; omit the action to show all preferences
example_config: Examples: mas config; mas config get language; mas config set language zh_cn
